verdict.rationale: Relay is a business banking platform, and a built-in AI assistant is a reasonable feature to ask about for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows an AI assistant. The 'delegate tasks' line in bill pay refers to handing work to team members, which is an adjacent workflow feature. Auto-transfer rules and approval workflows are rule-based automation, not AI delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
